## The field (all the reviewer needs; the tool's scores are hidden)
Dryland cropland, Riley County, Kansas (39.12 °N, 96.63 °W, 322 m). Soils: Wymore silty clay loam (~78 %, clay
increases sharply to ~46 % at 6–11 in; slow subsoil permeability; USDA describes the series as moderately well drained),
Chase and Reading silty clay loams (~22 %). Topsoil pH ≈ 6.1, organic matter ≈ 3 %. Rain ≈ 907 mm/yr (GPM IMERG
2005–2025); May–Sep reference ET ≈ 769 mm vs rain ≈ 562 mm. Current rotation: corn ↔ soybean every year since 2010.
